clips.title: The story
paras: The Library Wing is the quiet, book-lined southern wing of Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest. It serves as a sanctuary for scholars, offering early instruction to fledgling priests and mages joining the defense of Stormwind.

Branching south from the Main Hall of Northshire Abbey, the Library Wing houses dusty shelves, study lecterns, and quiet alcoves dedicated to intellectual and spiritual training. While martial recruits drill in the northern Hall of Arms, aspiring mages and priests gather here to grasp the fundamentals of the Arcane and the Holy Light. Currently, Priestess Anetta guides novice priests in matters of faith and healing, while Khelden Bremen teaches budding mages how to shape primal elemental energy.
